name: Femi-Nemesis (Bronze) card
summary: A Bronze Femi-Nemesis card from the Ed Universe set, one of 18 collectible card sets.
body: Fextralife lists the Bronze Femi-Nemesis card in the Ed Universe set, a comic set of 36 cards and one of 18 collectible card sets.

Fextralife's directions place it on Maroon Key: drive Aerostat Rd toward the blimp in the middle of the key, climb the rusted observation tower beside the road, and check the blue plastic chair by the railing on the raised platform.
Fextralife lists the card sets on its All Collectible Cards Set Locations page, which covers 18 sets.

name: Aurium Condominiums Knife Flight
summary: A Knife Flight in Vice City that PowerPyx lists among the 40 in GTA 6.
body: PowerPyx lists the Aurium Condominiums Knife Flight as number 12 of the 40 Knife Flights in GTA 6, under its Vice City heading.
PowerPyx says a Knife Flight is completed by flying a plane sideways between two tall buildings.

name: Tisha-Wocka Flea Market West (Under the Bridge)
summary: An Under the Bridge stunt in Vice City from GTABase's map of 202.
body: GTABase's map lists Tish-Wocka Flea Market West as Under the Bridge #100 of 202, in Vice City; Under the Bridge stunts are completed by flying a plane or helicopter beneath the structure.
GTABase places it between Tisha-Wocka Flea Market Central (#99) and Tisha-Wocka Flea Market East (#101), and spells only this entry "Tish-Wocka".

name: Lake Leonida Lock South Stunt Jump
summary: A stunt jump at Lake Leonida that PowerPyx and GTABase list among the 130 in GTA 6.
body: PowerPyx lists the Lake Leonida Lock South Stunt Jump under Leonard County on its list of 130 Stunt Jumps in GTA 6.
GTABase's map lists it as Stunt Jump #103 in Ambrosia, next to the Lake Leonida Lock Southwest (#102) and West (#104) jumps.
